The Bakers jacket is our take on a classic chore jacket. With a design that dates back to the earliest days of Universal Works, it has become one of our signature styles. The name “Bakers” was adopted from our Co-Founder and Designer's father, who wore a simple coverall for his job as a baker. Whilst conforming to the key principles of a chore jacket (a simple utility garment, often worn as a protective layer), our Bakers jacket has several distinctive features; from seams to create the shape, layered pockets and our signature diagonal buttonhole on the button stand. This jacket is a great everyday staple designed to be worn wherever and however you like.
Made in a vintage style from 13oz narrow loom red selvedge denim, this fabric goes through a slow process similar to American denim in the last century. p-howlerbros-8288824852595.d: Built for the long haul, the Waxed Depot Jacket takes our Depot silhouette into tougher terrain with heavyweight, naturally breathable wet waxed cotton from Halley Stevensons in Dundee, Scotland. This heritage fabric breaks in with every wear, made to protect against heavier rain and harsher outdoor environments while getting better over time. Unlike drier wax finishes, wet wax cotton is infused with more wax during production, giving it a softer feel, enhanced weather resistance, and the ability to develop rich character with age. Fully lined with our La Grange Lightweight Flannel for comfort, finished with a corduroy collar, and designed to crease and mold to your shape over time. Rugged, timeless, and guaranteed to look better the more miles you put on it.
